name: chart
title: Chart colours, legend and donut
description: Theme-aware chart series (var(--chart-1) … var(--chart-8), brand first), an SVG donut and a legend whose text stays ink while only the swatch carries the colour. Canvas chart libraries read the same colours with TwinX.chartColors(n) and redraw on TwinX.onTheme(fn).
whenToUse: Any chart, donut, legend or coloured series. Never pick series colours yourself and never colour legend text: series 1 is always the brand colour, then gold, green, red, amber, slate. Put the chart inside one titled tx-card (no frame around the chart itself).

variants.description: SVG donut (viewBox 0 0 36 36, r 15.915 so dasharray values are percentages).
Total and micro label in the middle of the donut.
Series colour 1 to 8 (tx-series-1 … tx-series-8) for slices, swatches, bars and fills.
Legend row; tx-legend--stack for a vertical list.
Chart and legend side by side.

a11y: Give the svg role="img" and an aria-label that states every value. The legend repeats the values in text, so colour is never the only cue.
